name: Text Multi-Vector Late Interaction
mechanism: Stores token-level passage vectors and computes query-token maximum similarities at retrieval time for fine-grained matching.
use_when: Retrieval quality justifies larger indexes and scoring cost
avoid_when: Index footprint or query latency is tightly bounded
A cross-encoder over a small dense candidate set already meets gates
failure_modes: Maximum similarity overweights spurious token matches
Compression changes ranking on rare terms
